name_input: IMCO OFFICE PRODUCTS INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/imco-office-products-international-private-limited) states "Total Shipments 1161 Records detected", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-16". Exact row quoted: "2026-02-16 | IMCO OFFICE PRODUCTS INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE LIMITED | SIA VIKSNA TRANS | BALL POINT PENS AS PER INVOICE (WE INTEND TO CLAIM REWARD UNDER REMISSION OF DUTIES AND TAXES ON EXPORTED PRODUCTS)- CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India | Riga, LATVIA | 96081019 | 9695485". Additional rows seen: 2026-02-12 to JSC OFFICE PREMIER, Vladivostok, RUSSIA, HS 96081019, BOL 9596621; 2026-01-27 to THE SAILOR PEN CO.,LTD, Kobe, JAPAN, HS 96081019, BOL 9075522; 2025-12-26 to THE SAILOR PEN CO.,LTD, Kobe, JAPAN, HS 96081019, BOL 8207324; 2025-12-10 to JSC OFFICE PREMIER, Vladivostok, RUSSIA, HS 96081019, BOL 7734262. Source counter: page claims 1161 total shipments; 5 individual dated export rows actually rendered on the free view (plus aggregate partner/port tables: 4 trading partners, 9 ports, top ports Vladivostok 82, CHENNAI SEA 74, Riga 49, KAMARAJAR PORT SEA 40, CHENNAI SEA INMAA1 29).
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with HS 96081019 (ball point pens) — note the declared HS 960810 is a 6-digit parent of the observed 8-digit 96081019, so the declared code is consistent, no correction needed. Destinations observed: Latvia, Russia, Japan; buyers include JSC Office Premier (Moscow), Erich Krause (HK/UAE), SIA Viksna Trans (Riga), QLM Alnjah (Riyadh). Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could NOT be retrieved: the web_search tool returned connection errors on all attempts and registry pages (thecompanycheck, zaubacorp) returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is recorded as unknown rather than none_found — absence of retrieved evidence is not evidence of absence. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free view and are left null; no numbers were invented. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is inconsistent with the observed product (writing instruments/office products), but per project rules this is not a rejection ground — company is accepted with the factual product noted.
